title: Add a callback to call when a config setting is altered
description:
This could potentially help with adding logging / notification logic in downstream product usages of `gcfgenv`

Examples:
- log when an environment variable overwrites a setting
- aggregate and store which environment variables were detected that matched the config struct

description: As the project matures, let's update the README language to make clear the current status

title: Add support for gcfg's struct tags
description:
The `gcfg` format supports renaming struct fields using a `"gcfg"` [struct tag](https://pkg.go.dev/gopkg.in/gcfg.v1#hdr-Data_structure). For example:

```go
type sec1 struct {
	F1 string `gcfg:"another-name"`
}

type config struct {
	Sec1 sec1 `gcfg:"sec2"`
}
```

Given the following input file:

```ini
[sec2]
another-name = value
````

You should end up with

```go
config{
	Sec1: sec1{F1: "value"},
}
```

And similarly, you should be able to set `SEC2_ANOTHER_NAME=value` and have it work with this package.

There is already [a test suite for this feature](https://github.com/rstudio/gcfgenv/blob/main/gcfgenv_test.go#L405-L440), but I never implemented it. But it seems that we use it internally in a few places, so we should probably add support for it. The [`reflect` package supports manipulating struct tags, of course](https://pkg.go.dev/reflect#example-StructTag).
